review: Fresh Blender import verified 18 meshes, finite vertices and nondegenerate faces. Front, rear, top and oblique garden prop views recorded in tmp/heartleaf-props. Hidden game captures compare all four reference layers and the assembled village; collision checks verify the rotated southern plaza gate.
modifications: Thicker freestanding fence rails and posts; raised cream limestone tree curb; narrower radial plaza paving around a larger grass opening, with layer-generated limestone texture; independent green-roof birdhouse added. Bench construction and CC0 painted trim retained. Five forward-facing sunflowers with warm yellow petals and dark brown seed centers replace the generic cluster. Added separate low-poly eave clover, using original solid-color materials. Existing models and embedded textures retained.
woodRevision: Golden timber UVs remapped to the existing quiet brown timber strip in the original reviewed CC0 trim atlas.
benchRevision: Curved benches face outward from the plaza trunk. Curved slat winding corrected after the facing change.
gardenRevision: Four-legged beehive with connected recessed tier seams and entrance ledge; taller three-cloth laundry line with pegs and sag; reusable hollow sixteen-stave wooden bucket with bands, thick rim and recessed soil. All fifteen retained models have unchanged exported positions, indices and UVs.
judge: Independent final review passed: continuous hive tier shell, visible body and legs below orchard canopy, three readable cloth colors in both gardens, hollow bucket rims and clear house/plaza approaches. Reviewed fresh front, rear, top, oblique and assembled game views.
